meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 能通过 Chat SDK 接入 Telegram 机器人:复制并注册 Telegram 适配器、配对辅助工具及其测试,安装固定版本的依赖包,构建并验证注册。随后收集 BotFather 的机器人令牌,重启服务,用一次性配对码把你指定的 Telegram 聊天绑定为频道入口,配对成功即可收发消息。
howto.when: 在 NanoClaw 初始化设置(/setup)流程中需要接入 Telegram 频道时,或通过 /init-first-agent、/manage-channels 命令把 Telegram 设为渠道时触发。用户要求配置或接入 Telegram 机器人时也会进入此流程。

say.text: 继续 /setup,帮我添加 Telegram 频道。
say.note: 会执行复制适配器、注册、安装依赖等步骤。

say.text: 用 /manage-channels 把 Telegram 接入现在的服务。
say.note: 会注册适配器,并提示创建机器人、获取 token。

say.text: 我已经创建好 Telegram bot,需要配对聊天。
say.note: 会运行配对步骤,给你 4 位配对码。

howto.what_en: Adds Telegram bot support to NanoClaw via Chat SDK: copies/registers the adapter, helpers and tests, installs the exact dependency, builds. Then captures the BotFather token, restarts, and pairs a chat with a 4-digit code to enable messaging.
howto.when_en: Triggered during NanoClaw's /setup when adding Telegram, or when wiring it via /init-first-agent or /manage-channels; also when the user asks to configure/connect a Telegram bot.

say_en.text: Continue /setup and add the Telegram channel for me.
say_en.note: Runs the copy, registration, and dependency install steps.

say_en.text: Use /manage-channels to connect Telegram to the current service.
say_en.note: Registers the adapter and prompts for bot creation and token.

say_en.text: I've created the Telegram bot; I need to pair the chat.
say_en.note: Runs pairing and shows a 4-digit code.
